q1.question: What is GetMedia?
q1.answer: GetMedia is a free desktop app for Windows that lets you download videos and audio from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and other sites, powered by yt-dlp.

q2.question: Is GetMedia really free?
q2.answer: Yes! GetMedia is 100% free and open source (MIT license). No subscriptions, trials or hidden costs.

q3.question: Which sites are supported?
q3.answer: GetMedia supports YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and every other site supported by yt-dlp.

q4.question: What formats and quality can I download?
q4.answer: You can download video or audio in the format of your choice, at the highest quality the source site offers.

q5.question: How do I install GetMedia?
q5.answer: Click the Download button, run the .exe installer and follow the steps. No extra dependencies are needed — yt-dlp and ffmpeg are bundled.

q6.question: Does GetMedia work on Mac or Linux?
q6.answer: Not yet. GetMedia is currently Windows-only, but other platforms may be supported in the future.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: GetMedia's privacy policy: minimal data collection, anonymous Google Analytics on the website and local-only processing in the desktop app.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: GetMedia is a free, open-source desktop application for Windows that lets you download videos and audio from supported sites. Your privacy matters to us: we collect as little data as possible, and the app itself never sends your data anywhere.
This policy explains what data is processed when you use this website and the GetMedia app.

sections.heading: Data processed by this website
paragraphs: This website uses Google Analytics to measure anonymous, aggregated usage — such as pages visited, approximate region and device type. There is no account system and no personal data (like your name or e-mail) is collected.
When you change the language in the settings, a small cookie stores your preference so the site opens in that language on your next visit.

sections.heading: Data processed by the app
paragraphs: The GetMedia app runs entirely on your computer. Videos and audio are downloaded locally using the bundled yt-dlp and ffmpeg, and your download history and settings are stored on your device only.
The app does not send your download history, the URLs you download, or any other personal information to us or to third parties.

sections.heading: Third-party services
paragraphs: The app is distributed through GitHub Releases and this website is hosted on Vercel; those services have their own privacy policies. The download button checks the latest release through the GitHub API.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.metaDescription: Terms of use for the GetMedia website and desktop application: MIT license, responsible use and limitation of liability.

sections.heading: Agreement to terms
paragraphs: By using this website, or by downloading and using the GetMedia application, you agree to these terms of use.

sections.heading: License
paragraphs: GetMedia is free, open-source software released under the MIT License. You may use, modify and redistribute it in accordance with that license.

sections.heading: Responsible use
paragraphs: GetMedia is a tool for downloading publicly available media. You are responsible for using it lawfully: only download content you have the right to, and respect the copyright and terms of service of the sites you download from (such as YouTube's Terms of Service).

sections.heading: Disclaimer of warranties
paragraphs: GetMedia is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind. Support for sites depends on the yt-dlp project and may change at any time; we cannot guarantee the app works with every site or format.

paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the GetMedia author shall not be liable for any damages arising from the use of the software or of this website.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the app or website after changes means you accept the updated terms.
